Message.Name: Start of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all quote channels and indicates the beginning of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: End of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all quote channels and indicates the end of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinType
Field.Description: Spin type: 1 = Reference, 2 = Market Data, 3 = Opening.

Field.Name: SpinMsgCt
Field.Description: Total number of messages in the spin.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: Market Open Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 6 AM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage caused a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketOpen
Field.Description: Market open time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: MarketClose
Field.Description: Anticipated market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Message.Name: Market Close Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 5 PM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage causes a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketCloseTimeMilli
Field.Description: Market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch midnight.

Field.Name: MarketMsgCt
Field.Description: Total message count for the trading day.

Message.Name: Security Message
Message.Description: The Security Message is included in all the quote channels and provides basic security attribute information.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol. Fixed income symbols may not have a symbol. For these securities, the security ID or CUSIP (Reference Data Security Message) must be used as an identifier.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique security ID issued by OTC Markets.

Field.Name: SecurityFlags
Field.Description: Security flags bitmap. See SecurityFlag definition.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: The market tier assigned by OTC Markets Group.

Message.Name: Quote Message
Message.Description: This message is sent on the Quote Book channel and the Quote Book with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: QuoteFlags
Field.Description: Quote flags bitmap. See QuoteFlag definition.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Market Participant ID owning the quote (always 4 characters).

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Ask price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: AskSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the ask.

Field.Name: AskQAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the ask. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: AskTimeMilli
Field.Description: Ask timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Bid price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the bid.

Field.Name: BidQAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the bid. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: BidTimeMilli
Field.Description: Bid timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: QuoteReferenceID
Field.Description: Numeric value (0–64,999) assigned by the quote owner (FIX Tag 9670), used for correlation purposes.

Field.Name: ExtendedQuoteFlags
Field.Description: Extended quote flags bitmap. See ExtendedQuote Flag definition.

Message.Name: Quote Update Message
Message.Description: Quote update information for the Quote Book channel and the Quote Book with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Quote ID referring back to the original quote reference.

Field.Name: QuoteFlags
Field.Description: Quote flags bitmap. See QuoteFlag definition.

Field.Name: QAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the bid/offer. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: QuoteTimeMilli
Field.Description: Quote timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: QuoteReferenceID
Field.Description: Numeric value (0–64,999) corresponding to FIX Tag 9670, assigned by the quote owner and used for correlation purposes.

Field.Name: ExtendedQuoteFlags
Field.Description: Extended quote flags bitmap. See ExtendedQuoteFlag definition.

Message.Name: Inside Message
Message.Description: This message is sent on the Quote Inside Channel and the Quote Inside with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: QuoteFlags
Field.Description: Inside quote flags bitmap. See Inside QuoteFlag definition.

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Ask price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: AskSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the ask.

Field.Name: AskTimeMilli
Field.Description: Ask timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Bid price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the bid.

Field.Name: BidTimeMilli
Field.Description: Bid timestamp in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: AskNumPricedMP
Field.Description: Number of market participants at the inside ask price level.

Field.Name: BidNumPricedMP
Field.Description: Number of market participants at the inside bid price level.

Message.Name: Inside Update Message
Message.Description: Quote update information for the Quote Inside channel and the Quote Inside with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: InsideID
Field.Description: Inside ID referring back to the original inside reference.

Field.Name: InsideTimeMilli
Field.Description: Inside timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: NumPricedMP
Field.Description: Number of market participants at the inside price level.

Message.Name: Reference Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent on the Reference Prices Channel. Size will always be set to 1.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Ask price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: AskTimeMilli
Field.Description: Ask timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Bid price, with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: BidTimeMilli
Field.Description: Bid timestamp in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Message.Name: Reference Price Update Message
Message.Description: Quote update information for the Reference Price channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: TimeMilli
Field.Description: Timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Message.Name: Extended Security Message
Message.Description: Extended Security message providing additional security and issuer attributes.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique security ID issued by OTC Markets.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: Market tier assigned by OTC Markets Group.

Field.Name: DisclosureStatus
Field.Description: Current disclosure status of the issuer.

Field.Name: ParValue
Field.Description: Par value with 6 decimal places assumed. 0 indicates not available.

Field.Name: Coupon
Field.Description: Coupon with 6 decimal places assumed. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: MaturityDateMilli
Field.Description: Maturity date in milliseconds from UTC epoch. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: CallableDateMilli
Field.Description: Callable date in milliseconds from UTC epoch. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: ADRRatio
Field.Description: ADR ratio with 6 decimal places assumed. Applies to ADR/GDR/NYRS securities only.

Field.Name: ADRLevel
Field.Description: ADR level. Applies to ADR/GDR/NYRS securities only.

Message.Name: Extended Security No Cusip Message
Message.Description: Extended Security message without CUSIP information. This message may be sent at system startup or intraday following a technical outage.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: ShortName
Field.Description: Name of the security. If not present, IssuerName should be used instead.

Field.Name: PrimaryMarket
Field.Description: Primary market or exchange where the security trades.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique security ID issued by OTC Markets.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: Market tier assigned by OTC Markets Group.

Field.Name: DisclosureStatus
Field.Description: Current disclosure status of the issuer.

Field.Name: ParValue
Field.Description: Par value with 6 decimal places assumed. Zero indicates not available.

Field.Name: Coupon
Field.Description: Coupon with 6 decimal places assumed. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: MaturityDateMilli
Field.Description: Maturity date in milliseconds from UTC epoch. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: CallableDateMilli
Field.Description: Callable date in milliseconds from UTC epoch. Applies to fixed income securities only.

Field.Name: ADRRatio
Field.Description: ADR ratio with 6 decimal places assumed. Applies to ADR/GDR/NYRS equity securities only.

Field.Name: ADRLevel
Field.Description: ADR level. Applies to ADR/GDR/NYRS equity securities only.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: A Trade Message is created for every trade that occurs on OTC Markets OTC Link ATS.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: Deprecated
Field.Description: Deprecated field. Spaces will be sent in the message.

Field.Name: TradePrice
Field.Description: Trade price with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: TradeTimeMilli
Field.Description: Trade timestamp in milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Composite.Name: Issuer
Composite.Description: Issuer information, including name and size.

Size.Name: IssuerSize
Size.Description: Size of the IssuerName field. If zero, IssuerName is not present.

Composite.Name: SecurityDetail
Composite.Description: Security Detail Information, including name and size.

Size.Name: SecurityDetailSize
Size.Description: Size of the SecurityDetail field. If zero, SecurityDetail is not present.

Field.Name: CaveatEmptorWarning
Field.Description: Indicates whether a Caveat Emptor warning has been applied to the security.

Field.Name: QualifiedInstitutionalBuyersOnly
Field.Description: Indicates if the security may only be quoted unsolicited for Qualified Institutional Buyers.

Field.Name: UnsolicitedOnly
Field.Description: Indicates if the security may only be quoted unsolicited.

Field.Name: BBQuoted
Field.Description: Indicates if the security is quoted on the OTC Bulletin Board interdealer quotation system.

Field.Name: OTCLinkECNEligible
Field.Description: Indicates if the security is eligible for OTC Link ECN.

Field.Name: OTCLinkMessagingDisabled
Field.Description: Indicates whether OTC Link messaging is disabled for the security.

Field.Name: SaturationEligible
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is eligible to have their quotes saturated.

Field.Name: QuoteSaturated
Field.Description: Quote should be considered for inside price

Field.Name: NMSConditionalQuote
Field.Description: Displayed quote size is a round lot at least two times greater than the minimum round lot size and cannot be partially filled.
